    Proposition 4.14: A₀ ≅ kP with P = ray A₀ #

    scalar-normalization.tex (prop:scalar-normalization): "For A₀ of Construction 2.8 and P = ray A₀, there is an isomorphism A₀ ≅ kP preserving the labelled primitive idempotents and homogeneous ray lines. In particular A₀ has a normed multiplicative basis."

    The table A0Mult of the normed ray basis basisR is the ray table of A₀ in the sense of Definition 3.9: it presents the rays of A₀ (A0Mult_rayPres; each ray contains a unique homogeneous line, Proposition 3.8, and homogeneous lines are the lines of basisR, eq_smul_basisR). With thetaA0 : kP ≃ A₀ (b_t ↦ basisR t, identities to the labelled idempotents) this is the proposition (scalarNormalization).

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.scalarNormalization {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] {c : MeshCoefficients k Q} {L : CatAlg.LocalFamily (meshFam Q c)} (D : CatAlg.MeshData (meshFam Q c) L) [IsAlgClosed k] [hone : ∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] [(x y : V) → Fintype (x ⟶ y)] [hfd : ∀ (x y : V), FiniteDimensional k (meshFam Q c x ⟶ meshFam Q c y)] (v₀ : V) (hF : IsRepresentationFinite k (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    (FpA0 D v₀ hF).IsRayPres (A0Mult D v₀ hF) (idxA0 D v₀ hF) ⇑(basisR D v₀ hF) ∧ (∀ (t : RayA0 D v₀), (thetaA0 D v₀ hF) ((A0Tab D v₀ hF).b k t) = (basisR D v₀ hF) t) ∧ (∀ (x : D.PV), (thetaA0 D v₀ hF) ((A0Tab D v₀ hF).b k ((A0Tab D v₀ hF).e x)) = MulOpposite.op (CatAlg.unitM x x (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (D.F0 x)))) ∧ (∀ (t : RayA0 D v₀), (lenA0 D ⋯).IsHom (dA D v₀ t) ((basisR D v₀ hF) t)) ∧ HasNormedMultiplicativeBasis k (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ

    Proposition 4.14 (prop:scalar-normalization): A₀ ≅ kP for P = ray A₀, preserving the labelled primitive idempotents and the homogeneous ray lines; A₀ has a normed multiplicative basis.
